item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.25)] Snag Some Ink-Redible Back-to-School Deals on Printers From Canon, Epson, and HP
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.25)
This article highlights back-to-school printer deals from top brands like Canon, Epson, and HP, emphasizing the ongoing need for physical copies for school and work. It provides detailed descriptions and pricing for various printer models, including all-in-one, monochrome, and photo printers, catering to different student and home office needs. The deals aim to help students save money and time by offering convenient and efficient printing solutions.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.32)] Chevron (CVX) Lands 20 Year AI Data Center Power Deal
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.32)
Chevron has secured a 20-year Project Kilby partnership with Microsoft to provide natural gas-fired power for AI data centers, integrating gas supply, carbon capture, and renewable energy. This deal positions Chevron as a long-term energy supplier for AI hyperscalers and reflects a growing trend in energy monetization driven by the increasing power demands of AI. The agreement highlights the continued relevance of natural gas in Chevron's earnings mix while connecting the company to the expanding digital infrastructure market.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.47)] Nvidia teams up with Wall Street asset managers on $500 billion AI infrastructure push
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.47)
Nvidia is collaborating with major Wall Street asset management firms, including Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, and KKR, on a $500 billion initiative to finance AI infrastructure. This partnership aims to help Nvidia's customers secure funding for high-end GPUs, data centers, and electricity capacity, highlighting the increasing role of private capital in the AI boom. An official announcement is expected soon, marking a significant step in addressing the substantial capital expenditures required for AI development.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.22)] Apple settles EEOC claims about antisemitic retail manager for $150K
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.22)
Apple has agreed to pay $150,000 to settle claims from the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) regarding an antisemitic retail manager. The lawsuit alleged that a manager at a Reston, Virginia Apple store made antisemitic comments, forced a Jewish employee to work on the Sabbath, and fired him after he refused to work on a Friday. Apple denied wrongdoing in the case, which involved claims of religious discrimination and retaliation under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] Coca-Cola Stock Recently Hit a New All-Time High. Has It Gotten Too Expensive?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
Coca-Cola stock has surged 25% in 2026, outperforming the S&P 500, and recently hit an all-time high. Despite this, the article questions if the stock is overvalued given its modest forecasted organic growth rate of around 5% this year, a decrease from previous years when inflation drove higher prices. The author suggests that while Coca-Cola is a safe, profitable company with a good dividend, its current valuation of 26 times earnings makes it an unattractive investment, especially considering its historical annual returns have not been strong.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.20)] Fortinet Inc Stock (FTNT) Moved Up by 3.35% on Aug 10: A Full Analysis
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.20)
Fortinet Inc. (FTNT) saw its stock rise by 3.35% on August 10, outperforming the Software & IT Services sector. This surge is attributed to the company exceeding institutional expectations in quarterly billings and free cash flow margins, driven by a strategic shift towards software-defined networking and AI integration. Despite macroeconomic uncertainties, strong enterprise contract growth and positive analyst revisions are bolstering investor confidence in Fortinet's operational efficiency and competitive positioning.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Pfizer's Earnings Have Declined 58% This Year. Is a Dividend Cut Around the Corner?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
Pfizer's earnings have fallen 58% this year, largely due to impairment charges, raising concerns about its dividend sustainability. While net income is down, the company's free cash flow of $11 billion over the past four quarters exceeds its dividend payments of $9.8 billion, suggesting the payout might still be safe for now. Although the stock has upside potential if acquisitions pay off, there's a risk of a dividend cut if Pfizer prioritizes cash conservation for future growth.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14)] CVX, OXY & XOM: The Next Big Move in Oil Could Be Just Getting Started
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14)
Oil prices have seen significant volatility in 2026, boosting major U.S. oil companies like Chevron (CVX), Exxon Mobil (XOM), and Occidental Petroleum (OXY). These companies have consistently beaten earnings expectations, fueled by factors such as commodity tailwinds, increasing AI-driven energy demand, LNG expansion, and strong shareholder returns through buybacks and deleveraging. Analysts are setting bull-case targets of $225 for CVX, $180 for XOM, and $75 for OXY, suggesting substantial upside potential for these stocks.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.40)] BofA: Nvidia's next earnings report could kick off a "multi-quarter upgrade cycle"
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.40)
Bank of America expects Nvidia's upcoming second-quarter earnings report to initiate a "multi-quarter upgrade cycle," with the chipmaker likely to surpass expectations and raise its outlook. The optimism stems from the imminent shipment of Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform and strong cloud capital spending. BofA maintains a Buy rating and a $350 price objective on Nvidia stock, anticipating revenue beats and higher guidance for the next quarter.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.42)] NVDA Teams Up With Wall Street Giants On Massive $500B AI Infrastructure Funding Push: Report
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.42)
Nvidia Corp. is reportedly in discussions with major financial firms like Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, BlackRock, and Goldman Sachs to secure a $500 billion funding package for AI infrastructure. This initiative aims to support investments in AI chips, power generation, and data centers. The move follows similar large AI infrastructure financing deals by these firms and complements Nvidia's existing $500 billion-plus partnership with SK Group for AI infrastructure and next-generation memory.

item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.21)] Uber Technologies Inc Stock (UBER) Moved Up by 3.20% on Aug 10: Key Drivers Unveiled
item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.20)] Netflix Is Down 42% From Its High. Here's Why I'm Buying More.
item.description:

Netflix shares have dropped significantly, by over 20% year-to-date and nearly 42% from their 52-week high, following disappointing earnings guidance. The author believes this presents a "buy the dip" opportunity due to the stock's low forward earnings multiple and potential catalysts like surging ad revenue and a substantial share repurchase program. Despite analyst estimates for modest growth, the author suggests a rebound is likely given the current valuation and market conditions.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Vistra supports Texas data center pause, execs say
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
Vistra Corp. executives support a pause on data center development in Texas to audit projects in the ERCOT interconnection queue, though they don't expect it to impact their 1.2-GW deal with Amazon. The company's generation business saw a significant increase in adjusted EBITDA in Q2 2026, driven by favorable hedging, and anticipates 4% to 6% annual load growth in ERCOT, fueled by diverse sources beyond just data centers. Vistra also notes progress in regulatory processes and customer appetite for energy and capacity contracts.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)] AI Cloud Provider Lambda Taps Loans for Nvidia-Tied Chip Deal
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)
Lambda Inc., an AI cloud-computing provider backed by Nvidia, is raising a $917 million leveraged loan to finance the purchase and installation of GPUs as part of a contract with Nvidia. This marks a new trend in financing AI infrastructure through the risky debt market, following a similar move by CoreWeave Inc. The debt, which has a short maturity and fully amortizing structure, is being pitched at an interest rate of up to 3.75 percentage points over the benchmark.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] Alphabet's Higher AI Spending Could Boost These ETFs
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
Alphabet is significantly increasing its AI-related capital expenditure, raising its 2026 guidance to $195-$205 billion. This aggressive investment, despite pressuring cash flow, is expected to drive demand for GPUs, memory chips, and networking equipment, benefiting companies like NVIDIA, Broadcom, and Micron Technology. Investors can gain diversified exposure to this AI spending trend through mega-cap technology ETFs and semiconductor ETFs with high Alphabet or key chipmaker weightings.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.30)] What is a Ford Fathom and Why is it Creating So Much Buzz
item.description:

Introduced at a dealer gathering, this lifestyle truck will feature BlueCruise capability, bidirectional power, and Apple Maps integration, starting at an MSRP of $28,350. Preorders are expected to begin in early 2027, with a full vehicle reveal promised by the end of 2026.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.26), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)] Synopsys (SNPS) Unleashes Agentic AI Chip Design Tools Backed by Microsoft, AMD
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.26), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)
Synopsys has launched new agentic AI workflows for chip design, developed with Microsoft and being evaluated by AMD, aiming to significantly reduce chip development time. While Synopsys demonstrates strong revenue growth and strategic partnerships, its stock has faced pressure due to amortization costs from the Ansys acquisition and significant stock-based compensation, alongside ongoing legal challenges. Investors are weighing the company's potential for continued growth in the AI buildout against these financial and legal concerns.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.10), MSFT Neutral (+0.06)] JPMorgan Leads $441 Million Debt Deal for AI Infrastructure Firm
item.description:

The company, founded in 2024, aims to provide secure and cost-effective AI infrastructure and reports $6.2 billion in contracted revenues. Global AI expects to achieve 1 gigawatt of capacity by 2029 to meet the increasing demand for AI infrastructure.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.13)] Palo Alto Networks Inc Stock (PANW) Moved Up by 4.00% on Aug 10: Key Drivers Unveiled
item.description:

The company's transition to recurring software revenue models and strong enterprise cybersecurity budgets are also contributing factors. Despite some risks like potential billings growth deceleration due to its strategic shift, the core investment thesis remains strong due to its integrated platform approach and scale.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.29), NVDA Bearish (-0.21)] Arm Holdings PLC Stock (ARM) Moved Down by 4.64% on Aug 10: What Investors Need To Know
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.29), NVDA Bearish (-0.21)
Arm Holdings PLC (ARM) stock decreased by 4.64% on August 10th, driven by sector-wide profit-taking, concerns over cooling AI investments, and the negative impact of higher interest rate expectations on its long-term valuation. Geopolitical tensions and regulatory risks in the Asia-Pacific region further suppressed investor confidence. The company's high valuation and sensitivity to macroeconomic factors are making it vulnerable to market volatility.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.21)] Ouster Stock Doubles YTD: Buy OUST After Another Quarter of Beat?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.21)
Ouster Inc. (OUST) has seen its stock double year-to-date after reporting a narrower-than-expected loss and a 56% year-over-year revenue increase in Q2 2026. The company is expanding beyond lidar into a unified sensing and perception platform, with growth fueled by acquisitions like StereoLabs and products like Rev8. Despite being unprofitable, strong revenue growth, strategic expansions, and a fortified balance sheet position OUST as a potential buy for investors seeking high-growth opportunities.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.04), MSFT Neutral (+0.03)] Tencent Music faces earnings test as competition intensifies By Investing.com
item.description:

Investors will focus on subscriber trends, social entertainment stabilization, and the profitability of its offline expansion as the company navigates increased market saturation.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Vistra: Strong Q2 Beat, Structural Growth Drivers and Data-Center Deals Support Buy Rating and $232 Price Target
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.31)

The rating is supported by robust long-term demand growth in ERCOT, progress in PJM, and significant data-center deals with companies like META and AMZN, all of which provide clear visibility into future cash flows.

The robust growth suggests that the AI trade still has significant potential for expansion.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02)] Microsoft Stock Facing Margin Pressures
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.02)
Microsoft (MSFT) is facing margin pressures despite high profitability, with its stock declining by 4.5% over the last year. The primary concern is not demand failure but increasing costs associated with fulfilling growing demand, particularly investments in AI infrastructure for Azure. Management forecasts a slight reduction in operating margins for fiscal 2027, even with predicted double-digit revenue and operating income growth, and two-thirds of capital expenditures in Q4 2026 were allocated to short-lived assets like CPUs and GPUs.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.35)] S&P 500 Earnings Hit Best Growth Since 2021: Here's Why - State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (ARCA:SPY)
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.35)
S&P 500 companies are on track for their strongest earnings growth in five years, with Q2 blended earnings up 50.4%, the highest since Q2 2021. While individual companies like Amazon and Alphabet significantly boosted overall figures, underlying growth remains robust, driven by sectors like Energy and Information Technology. Analysts project continued strong earnings growth through 2026, with AI playing a crucial role.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.21)] Sony, TSMC to build $6.29bn image sensor plant in Japan – report
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.21)
Sony Group and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) are set to establish a $6.29 billion image sensor plant in Kumamoto, Japan, with production slated to begin by 2029. This joint venture, where Sony will hold about 60% and TSMC 40%, aims to produce advanced image sensors for applications like Apple's iPhones and AI systems. The companies are also seeking government financial support and view this partnership as a move towards a "fab-light" model for Sony and an expansion of TSMC's expertise in image sensors and physical AI.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.22)] RBC Capital reiterates Applied Materials stock rating on WFE strength
item.description:

RBC Capital has reiterated an Outperform rating on Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) with a $520 price target, expecting the company to exceed estimates and raise guidance due to strengthening trends in DRAM, HBM, and Advanced Packaging. The firm anticipates double-digit wafer fabrication equipment growth for the next three years, driven by generative AI and technology transitions. While other analysts have offered mixed opinions, with Erste Group downgrading the stock and Stifel and Mizuho raising price targets, the overall outlook highlights Applied Materials' strong market position.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Tilray Brands Expects to Hit a Major Milestone for the Current Fiscal Year: $1 Billion in Annual Revenue. Here's How it Plans to Get There
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
Tilray Brands is targeting over $1 billion in annual revenue for the current fiscal year (fiscal 2027), an 11% increase from the previous year's $915.5 million. The company plans to achieve this through continued expansion in international markets and acquisitions in its craft beer segment. Despite this growth, Tilray faces challenges with profitability, having incurred a $105 million loss in the past fiscal year, which continues to weigh on its stock performance.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.12)] Barrick and Newmont Settle Feud, Clearing Path for North American IPO
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (-0.12)
Barrick Gold and Newmont have settled all disputes regarding their Nevada Gold Mines joint venture, with Newmont paying $1.95 billion, removing the final obstacle for Barrick’s North American gold assets IPO. The agreement includes previously excluded projects and improved governance, ending a long-standing rivalry between the two mining giants. This settlement comes as Barrick aims to complete the IPO by year-end, with Mark Hill appointed CEO of the new entity, seeking to boost investor confidence and improve Barrick's market position.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.03)] Nvidia investing up to $3 billion in Lancium for Stargate
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.03)
Nvidia is investing up to $3 billion in Lancium, the power infrastructure company behind the Stargate AI data center initiative, with the deal potentially growing by another $1 billion based on performance benchmarks. The transaction values Lancium at approximately $10 billion and aims to expand its operations, with a possible public offering in 2027. This investment highlights Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's focus on AI infrastructure and the crucial role of land, power, and financing in the industry's growth.

Safe Pro Group will also host an Innovation Day in Aventura, Florida, on August 25, 2026.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.10), AMZN Neutral (+0.12)] Oracle’s Rebound Is All But Assured So I Keep Buying
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.10), AMZN Neutral (+0.12)
The author is bullish on Oracle (ORCL) despite a significant stock price drop, citing an "embarrassingly simple" reason: a massive and rapidly growing contracted backlog. Oracle's Remaining Performance Obligations have soared to $638 billion, largely driven by AI workloads, with a substantial portion expected to convert to revenue in the coming year, pre-funding future guidance. The company's unique multicloud strategy, embedding its datacenters within competitors' clouds, positions it to profit regardless of which hyperscaler dominates.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Credo to Contribute OmniConnect Scale-In Interconnect Solution to the Open Compute Project to Address AI Inference Memory Wall
item.source: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd - Investor Relations
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd announced its plan to contribute its OmniConnect scale-in interconnect solution to the Open Compute Project (OCP) to address the AI inference memory wall. Credo has formed the OCP Open Chiplet Economy (OCE) Lightweight Serial Interconnect (LSI) Workstream and will contribute its OmniConnect lightweight AXI framer specification. This initiative aims to reduce dependence on High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and enable composable AI architectures with increased memory density and bandwidth.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02)] Robert W. Baird Issues Positive Forecast for Five9 (NASDAQ:FIVN) Stock Price

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.10)] Sony and TSMC are planning to invest $6.4 billion in a Japanese image sensor factory
item.description:

Sony and TSMC are reportedly planning a joint investment of $6.4 billion in a new image sensor factory in Japan, targeting production by 2029. The facility, to be located within Sony's Kumamoto campus, will focus on next-generation sensors for the automotive and robotics sectors. This venture is part of Sony's strategy to reduce its capital-heavy manufacturing exposure and aligns with Japan's interest in supporting advanced chip production.

item.title: [AMZN Bearish (-0.24)] Taylor Farms Issues Voluntary Recall Of Jalapeño Products Over Salmonella Risk Hitting Walmart (NYSE: WMT) and Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN)
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bearish (-0.24)
Taylor Farms has issued a voluntary recall of over a dozen jalapeño-containing products, including salsas and guacamole, across the United States due to salmonella concerns. This action follows an earlier recall by Coast Citrus Distributors and affects major retailers like Walmart, Amazon's Whole Foods Market, Kroger, Target, and Trader Joe's. The recall comes amidst an ongoing investigation into a salmonella outbreak and a separate cyclospora parasite outbreak tied to Taylor Farms' produce, highlighting vulnerabilities in the consolidated produce industry supply chain.

item.description:
